title: Minor Burn
immediate_warning: Cool the burn immediately with cool running water for at least 10 minutes.

immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cool the burn immediately with cool running water for at least 10 minutes.

immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cool the burn immediately with cool running water for at least 10 minutes.

description: A minor burn affects only the outer layer of skin. It causes redness, pain, and sometimes blisters but heals without surgery.

description_translations.en: A minor burn affects only the outer layer of skin. It causes redness, pain, and sometimes blisters but heals without surgery.

steps.instruction: Immediately hold the burned area under cool (not cold) running water for 10–20 minutes.

instruction_translations.en: Immediately hold the burned area under cool (not cold) running water for 10–20 minutes.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Immediately hold the burned area under cool (not cold) running water for 10–20 minutes.

instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Immediately hold the burned area under cool (not cold) running water for 10–20 minutes.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Immediately hold the burned area under cool (not cold) running water for 10–20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Remove jewellery or tight items near the burn before swelling starts.

instruction_translations.en: Remove jewellery or tight items near the burn before swelling starts.

instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove jewellery or tight items near the burn before swelling starts.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove jewellery or tight items near the burn before swelling starts.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove jewellery or tight items near the burn before swelling starts.

steps.instruction: Do not break any blisters — they protect against infection.

do_not: Do not apply toothpaste, oil, egg white, or any home remedy.
Do not use ice or ice water — it can worsen the burn.
